about:
Founded in 1972, Pasco Tool & Plastics Inc. has operated from Meadville, Pennsylvania for over five decades. The company provides tooling, machining, and injection molding services from a 28,000-square-foot, temperature-controlled facility designed to hold close tolerances on critical applications.

Its capabilities span tool design and manufacture, precision machining, and plastic injection molding, supported by a full-service quality control and metrology department. Equipment in that department is calibrated to traceable national standards, and the shop runs first-article inspections with pre-production part approval processes (PPAP) for each project. The facility's climate control helps maintain dimensional stability across production runs.

The company serves automotive, electronics, military, medical, and safety-product markets. Customers range from original equipment manufacturers to tiered suppliers requiring close-tolerance components for critical applications. Each project receives personal attention, with professional guidance offered from initial design through final delivery.

Management emphasizes that quality is built into daily routines rather than inspected in at the end. The firm differentiates itself by staying involved throughout the production cycle, offering professional guidance from design approval through final delivery. Teamwork and continuous improvement are cited as core to their quality commitment.
